name: Crisis Communications War Room
description: Rapid-response template for coordinating public, customer, internal, and executive communications during a crisis.

sections.title: Situation Snapshot
sections.instruction: Summarize what is known, what is uncertain, current severity, and the latest verified update

sections.title: Stakeholder Map
sections.instruction: List affected audiences, information needs, communication channels, and sentiment if discussed

sections.title: Approved Messages
sections.instruction: Capture statements, talking points, holding lines, FAQs, and language that has been approved

sections.title: Do Not Say
sections.instruction: List claims, speculative statements, sensitive details, or phrasing participants agreed to avoid

sections.title: Open Facts To Verify
sections.instruction: List unknowns that must be verified before messaging can advance

sections.title: Outbound Plan
sections.instruction: List communications to send, audience, owner, approval path, channel, and target time

sections.title: Escalations
sections.instruction: Capture legal, security, executive, customer, media, or regulator escalations and owners
